correctness.rationale: The full domain, Fourier normalization and quantifiers are explicit in RESULT.md. The identity E’=2(d-1)f’²/x forces strictly increasing critical extrema and simple roots. Differentiation proves monotone qx, exactly n−1 nondegenerate stationary points and their curvature signs. Uniform fixed-order Bessel asymptotics give parity-resolved phases and the 1/n radius correction; a parity-split Riemann-sum pushforward proves the density and central-window probability. Three checkers were rerun from the embedded paths (40 selected critical equations, 399 critical equations times five dimensions with 15 limiting-frequency comparisons, and 32 independently integrated three-dimensional transforms). Numerical tests are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Every ambient dimension supplies a natural complete probability law for high-index stationary diffraction-zero locations; the d=3 to d=4 transition from finite central density to an integrable cusp is a qualitative geometric phase transition. The two-parity formula and first-scale radial correction quantify the precise oscillatory mechanism and permit predicting detailed zero-response statistics for shell interpolation and diffraction.
